title: DeclutterUI
description: Hide annoying warnings, buttons, and popups
body:
### Main Menu
- Hide Realms button
- Hide Accessibility button
- Hide Language button
- Hide splash text
- Hide copyright notice
- Hide version and modded text
- Skip narrator setup screen on first launch

### In-Game
- Hide recipe book button
- Hide Player Reporting button
- Hide Open to LAN button
- Hide chat indicators
- Hide selected-item name popup

### Menus
- Hide Credits & Attribution button
- Hide Online Options button
- Hide Feedback and Report Bugs buttons

### Popups & Notifications
- Hide advancement notifications
- Hide recipe unlock notifications
- Hide tutorial popups
- Hide narrator toggle popup
- Hide unsafe server warning
- Hide world backup success popup
- Hide resource-pack error popups

### Warnings
- Skip online play warning
- Skip experimental world warning
- Skip world upgrade backup screen

### Other
- Turn off telemetry
- Categorized in-game settings
